about: Keeper's knowledge-graph contract vectors (syncular/README.md, The knowledge graph). Every implementation must reproduce each entry. Expansion: an entry with fill {text,count} replaces the one "{FILL}" in its json text (or in a string of its ops) with text repeated count times; an entry with repeat n uses n copies of its single op, with ordinals 0..n-1. changes[]: a graph.apply payload (json text) the change rules accept, or refuse with a code. algebra[]: an accepted pre-change state (images), a payload and the ids the server mints in order; the event's operations, delta_digest and the receipt's affected list, or the conflict detail, or a refusal. contents[]: stable content's revision rule at the type level: a content image, an update, and its one update operation with delta_digest, or the conflict detail, or a refusal. An entry with fills {NAME: {text,count}} replaces every "{NAME}" inside any of its strings with text repeated count times. queries[]: a KG-Cypher/1 source with its parameters (json text) and optional profile (default KG-Cypher/1); fill replaces the one "{FILL}" in its source, else in its parameters. Admitted entries give the engine text, the normalised parameters (when listed), the aliases and the limit; refused ones the code. prefix_chains[]: the chained prefix digest of events [graph_seq, delta_digest] from prefix_genesis. manifests[]: a generation manifest a worker reads, or the code it refuses with. worker: the engine, projection version, Linux worker allocator tunables and prefix genesis every consumer and worker share. An algebra entry state may hold contents (content images; absent is none) and a stamp {time_ms, actor_id}: the acceptance a verify_assertion is stamped with (absent: time 1, actor "vector-actor"). node_properties[]: a node kind and its properties (json text), admitted with its reserved members or refused with a code. locators[]: a $locator envelope (json text) as a Resource holds it, admitted or refused. assertion_currency[]: a graph now (nodes, edges, contents) and a node; whether its verification is current, read with no write.
